title: Email Signature
slide_intent: Teach how a sender can make role and affiliation easy to find at the end of an email. Each line should help the recipient identify or contact the person.
strategic_value: CSAIL can give everyday messages a consistent institutional signature while accommodating individual roles and groups.
demonstration: A mock email includes a message followed by a stacked block for name, pronouns, role, group, institution, website, email, phone, social handle and address. The logo sits beneath.
practical_value: Use the sample to order the relevant details for a sender, then place the identifier below the contact block.

content_islands.name: Signature rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and prose on recognition and professional tone in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Email context
content_islands.spec: Give the wider field a message header, greeting and short body before the sample signature.

content_islands.name: Contact block
content_islands.spec: Stack identity, contact channels and physical address in groups. Finish with the colored CSAIL mark.
